articles.title: Massie files resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
bullets: Rep. Thomas Massie filed an impeachment resolution against Pete Hegseth.
The resolution cites the Iran war, civilian deaths and alleged abuse of power.
The move follows Democratic gains in the 2026 midterm elections.

articles.title: Trump rejects immigration ‘amnesty’ after saying deportation policy was too tough
bullets: Trump described his deportation policy as “very strong.”
He rejected suggestions of an immigration amnesty.
AP polling found many midterm voters said enforcement had gone too far.

articles.title: Most Americans want new Democratic Congress to end Trump’s Iran war, poll finds
bullets: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found broad opposition to continuing the Iran war.
The finding comes after Democrats won control of Congress.
The result increases pressure on Trump’s Middle East policy.

articles.title: White House briefly locked down after nearby car crash
bullets: A vehicle crash near the White House triggered a brief lockdown.
Authorities detained two people after the incident.
The lockdown was reported among major overnight US headlines.

articles.title: AP: Federal decision advances Texas river project despite environmental objections
bullets: Environmental groups criticized approval tied to a major Texas river project.
Opponents called it a threat to a wild river landscape.
The story led AP’s overnight US news-in-brief package.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly four hours of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
bullets: Delegations met in Abu Dhabi for talks mediated by the United States.
The meeting lasted nearly four hours, AP reported.
Earlier rounds this year produced no major breakthrough.

articles.title: Overnight strikes in Yemen kill at least one and wound nine
bullets: Strikes hit Yemen overnight, including near an oil facility in Sanaa.
At least one person was killed and nine were wounded.
Residents reported explosions near residential areas.

articles.title: Trump says Iran war is militarily ‘effectively over’ after Qatar talks
bullets: Trump spoke after meeting Qatar’s prime minister.
He said the Iran war was militarily “effectively over.”
He suggested renewed US bombardment was not imminent.

articles.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 1/2 years in prison
bullets: A London court sentenced Russell Brand on Monday.
He was convicted of raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others.
The case followed earlier media investigations into allegations against him.

articles.title: Cameroon’s Paul Biya sets February 7 date for delayed polls
bullets: President Paul Biya set delayed legislative and local elections for February 7.
Biya is widely described as the world’s oldest leader.
The announcement appeared in global headline roundups Tuesday.

articles.title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers
bullets: New Delhi was covered by thick smog after Diwali celebrations.
Firecrackers worsened already dangerous seasonal pollution.
Low winds and cooler temperatures trapped pollutants.

articles.title: Three workers die at Tata Electronics Hosur plant
bullets: Three workers died at a utility facility at Tata Electronics’ Hosur plant.
The facility was operated by Nalco Water, PTI reported.
Tamil Nadu officials said the incident would be thoroughly probed.

articles.title: Election Commission extends neutrality rules to retired officials
bullets: India’s Election Commission tightened poll-time neutrality norms.
Restrictions now cover some retired or re-employed officials.
The order applies to individuals engaged by state governments.

articles.title: Survey says 38.6 million Indian adults have undiagnosed diabetes
bullets: A new survey estimated 38.6 million adults have undiagnosed diabetes.
The finding appeared among Tuesday’s top India health headlines.
The report highlights gaps in screening and diagnosis.

articles.title: Supreme Court asks WhatsApp and others about anti-cybercrime measures
bullets: India’s Supreme Court sought details from WhatsApp and other platforms.
The court asked about measures against digital arrest scams.
Cybercrime prevention was among Tuesday’s major legal headlines.

articles.title: AMD jumps after AI-chip rebound and analyst upgrade
bullets: AMD rose sharply in Monday’s AI-chip rebound.
Reports cited an Oppenheimer upgrade and Google TPU-related demand.
The move led several semiconductor gainers.

articles.title: Nvidia lags despite broader AI-stock bounce
bullets: Nvidia fell Monday while several AI-linked stocks recovered.
The company is investigating issues involving CEO Jensen Huang.
Investors weighed governance and China-exposure concerns.

articles.title: Broadcom rallies with semiconductor rebound
bullets: Broadcom was among major chip stocks rebounding Monday.
The AI trade recovered after last week’s steep tech selloff.
Investors rotated into chip names beyond Nvidia.

articles.title: Micron rises as chip demand optimism returns
bullets: Micron gained during the semiconductor rebound.
Reuters reported Micron was higher in Tuesday premarket trading.
AI infrastructure demand remained a key market driver.

articles.title: Delta rises as oil slide boosts travel shares
bullets: Delta Air Lines rose as crude prices declined.
Lower fuel costs improved sentiment toward airline stocks.
The move came during Monday’s broad US equity rebound.

articles.title: Anthropic targets blockbuster IPO in major AI-market test
bullets: Anthropic is preparing one of the largest AI-related IPOs.
Reuters reported disputed early pricing details were circulated then withdrawn.
The deal is seen as a test of AI-investor appetite.

articles.title: PepsiCo to cut about 1,000 jobs as North American business struggles
bullets: PepsiCo plans to cut roughly 1,000 jobs.
The reductions target a struggling North American business.
The move was cited in Tuesday market-news roundups.

articles.title: SoftBank swings to $7 billion quarterly loss
bullets: SoftBank reported a $7 billion loss for the September quarter.
AI and US data-center investments weighed on results.
Shares had rallied in Tokyo before the earnings release.

articles.title: Indian Hotels and Ambuja plan ₹2,700-crore West Bengal hospitality expansion
bullets: Indian Hotels and Ambuja announced a large hospitality expansion plan.
The West Bengal pipeline includes Taj-branded projects.
The investment is valued at about ₹2,700 crore.

articles.title: WEF says India is a leading example of bioeconomy growth
bullets: The World Economic Forum highlighted India’s bioeconomy development.
It said demand and supply are growing together in India.
Governments globally are increasing bioeconomy investments.

articles.title: Microsoft presses Trump administration to halt expected Chinese data-center tech ban
bullets: Microsoft is lobbying against an expected FCC-related import ban.
The issue involves Chinese optical transceivers used in data centers.
Reuters reported several companies are pressing the administration.

articles.title: Nvidia faces scrutiny over CEO’s ties to Chinese businesswoman
bullets: Nvidia said it is investigating issues involving Jensen Huang.
US intelligence reportedly linked the businesswoman to information gathering for China.
The matter renewed concerns about AI-chip access.

articles.title: Apple supply chain in India faces fires, protests and pollution issues
bullets: Reuters reported multiple pressures on Apple’s India supply chain.
Issues include fires, protests and pollution concerns.
The report came amid broader scrutiny of India manufacturing operations.

articles.title: TSMC October revenue surges as AI-chip demand stays strong
bullets: TSMC reported October revenue sharply higher year over year.
The result reinforced strong global demand for AI chips.
US-listed chip shares moved higher after the report.

articles.title: Anthropic launches new Claude models ahead of IPO push
bullets: Anthropic launched new Claude models, according to headline roundups.
The release comes as the company prepares for an IPO.
AI infrastructure spending remains central to investor focus.
